title: Grateful Dead Live at McFarlin Auditorium, SMU on 1969-12-26
source: MSR> CASS> DAT> CDR> EAC> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a smoking 1969 show – crystal‑clear acoustic gems and a soaring Dark Star make this a standout recording.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers an almost pristine soundboard mix, with silky low end and crystal‑clear highs that let the intimate acoustic set shine.  The performance is high‑energy throughout, highlighted by a flawless “All Around This World/ Little Sadie/ Long Black Limo/ Uncle John’s Band” sequence, a superb China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider segue, and an otherworldly Dark Star.  Even the rare “(Gathering Flowers For) The Master’s Bouquet” is captured in vivid detail.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive 5‑star comments (13 of 15 reviews) praise both the musical performance and the sound quality; recordings are described as crisp, silky, and crystal clear, while the show is called “smoking,” “breathtaking,” and a “hidden gem.”

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced mix with silky smooth lows and crystal‑clear highs; reviewers note the tape sounds like a high‑end studio capture. Minor gripe: New Speedway Boogie track is slightly cut.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A breathtaking acoustic set flows seamlessly into an electric second half, with Uncle John's Band serving as a perfect bridge; the China>Rider transition is highlighted as flawless.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as playing his brown‑sunburst Strat with “full of ideas” improvisation on Dark Star; guitar tone praised as perfect and silky.
band_member_comments.Phil: Repeatedly called out for a powerful, Alembic‑modified EB‑0 bass performance; especially highlighted during the Dark Star jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocal harmonies noted as spot‑on throughout, particularly on Uncle John's Band and acoustic numbers.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s B‑3 organ work described as inspired, trippy, and a key driver in the electric set (especially on China Cat Sunflower).
